Downtown Orlando.name: Downtown Orlando
Downtown Orlando.description: Church Street and Lake Eola civic core with office-to-residential conversions and the densest business-tax pipeline.

Thornton Park.name: Thornton Park
Thornton Park.description: Brick-street bungalow grid east of Lake Eola with renovation-led licensing and neighborhood retail.

SoDo.name: SoDo
SoDo.description: South of Downtown warehouse and creative-office conversions along Orange Avenue.

College Park.name: College Park
College Park.description: North-of-downtown streetcar suburb with Edgewater Drive retail and high STR turnover.

Ivanhoe Village.name: Ivanhoe Village
Ivanhoe Village.description: Mills Avenue corridor between downtown and College Park with adaptive-reuse commercial.

Princeton / Silver Star.name: Princeton / Silver Star
Princeton / Silver Star.description: Industrial-adjacent north side with contractor and service-license density along Silver Star.

Baldwin Park.name: Baldwin Park
Baldwin Park.description: Master-planned New Urbanist village on the former Navy base with mixed-use and professional offices.

Milk District.name: Milk District
Milk District.description: Colonialtown east-of-downtown grid with brewery/retail conversions and short-term rental pressure.

Audubon Park.name: Audubon Park
Audubon Park.description: Garden-district bungalows along Corrine Drive with independent retail and renovation licenses.

South Orange.name: South Orange
South Orange.description: Orlando Health medical corridor on South Orange Avenue with professional and clinical licensing.

Conway.name: Conway
Conway.description: Lakeside residential south of downtown with small-lot infill and neighborhood services.

Airport North.name: Airport North
Airport North.description: MCO-adjacent logistics and hospitality licensing north of the airfield.

International Drive / Florida Center.name: International Drive / Florida Center
International Drive / Florida Center.description: Tourist-corridor hospitality, retail, and body-art licensing along International Drive.

Metro West.name: Metro West
Metro West.description: West-side planned community and office park with service and contractor licenses.

Kirkman / Universal Edge.name: Kirkman / Universal Edge
Kirkman / Universal Edge.description: Kirkman Road hospitality and contractor spine at the Universal resort edge.

Lake Nona South / Medical City.name: Lake Nona South / Medical City
Lake Nona South / Medical City.description: Nemours / UCF Medical City campus with physician and professional-firm licensing.

Lake Nona Central.name: Lake Nona Central
Lake Nona Central.description: Town-center mixed-use and residential buildout east of the airport.

Airport South.name: Airport South
Airport South.description: Airside industrial and cargo licensing south of MCO.
